steps.what: Check actual data samples, methods, units, qualifiers and missing values before preparing environmental charts
Prepare charts or graphs from the checked data samples using reusable native plotting specifications in {BI}
Write summary information on the environmental relevance and check charts, units, uncertainty and conclusions against the samples
outputs: checked final charts and relevance summary

steps.what: Save the checked charts and relevance summary in {DOCS}
inputs: checked final charts and relevance summary

tasks.design: Configure reusable plots in {BI} over a checked dataset from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The scientist chooses meaningful comparisons, preserves qualifiers and writes the environmental relevance summary, then checks the complete output before saving in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated chart formatting and data arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native plot specifications can reuse axes, units and grouping.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing what a sample does and does not show.

ambition.what: No additional monitoring or public advice is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less plot assembly, unchanged scientific judgement.

evidence.claim: Native plotting can reuse chart specifications while sample validation and environmental interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is chart and relevance-summary preparation, not sample collection or statutory submission. No send is implied by saving this output.

The laboratory supplies sample ID, site, time, analyte, result, unit, detection limit, method and qualifier. The scientist checks them in s1 and sets grouping and axes in s2. Missing qualifiers or inconsistent units require manual resolution; no new free collection is assumed.

Native plotting first. Savings are repeat arrangement and formatting only; substantive data checks and final environmental summary remain fully counted. Normal final check in s3 binds the exact saved output. Shares are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Current plot reuse and sample compatibility.
research_questions: Can configured plots preserve detection-limit qualifiers across refreshes?

already_counted.description: Sample validation and final scientific summary remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain plot specifications and schema mapping.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final charts and summary checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 60% less chart assembly on 40 share gives 24 gross points less 1.5 upkeep. Low is existing configured plots or incompatible samples.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research pollution sources and abatement methods.

steps.what: Define the pollution-source question and evaluate actual source and environmental observations
Locate relevant research on pollution sources, pathways, effects and control using native literature filters in the research catalogue {OTHER}
Research sources of pollution by reading the actual evidence, assessing environmental effects and developing defensible abatement theories or methods
Write and check research findings, source references, limits and proposed abatement methods in {DOCS}
Save the checked research findings in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure saved queries and explicit filters in the research catalogue {OTHER} to reduce repeated source retrieval. The scientist reads the sources, evaluates effects and writes abatement hypotheses; generated summaries do not replace evidence or invent control effectiveness.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated literature retrieval can interrupt scientific synthesis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filters can reuse a declared search scope.
tasks.still_hard: Establishing causal pathways and feasible control methods.

ambition.what: No automatic pollution-control decision is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less search repetition, unchanged research responsibility.

reach.learn: Separate evidence from untested control assumptions.

evidence.claim: Saved literature queries can reduce repeated retrieval while causal interpretation and method development remain scientific work.

assumptions: Boundary includes research and its actual findings record; field sampling and implementing controls are separate. Data from prior work remains input, not a second saving.

Measurement producers supply site, time, source, analyte, unit and method; catalogue publishers supply actual title, identifier, abstract and full source. The scientist sets search criteria and handles missing references manually in s2-s3.

Native filters first. The digest's active-learning option is not required without a large screening corpus and validated stop rule; full scientific reading remains. The normal author check in s4 binds the saved findings.
unknowns: Volume of repeated searches and existing saved queries.
research_questions: Do saved queries improve retrieval without excluding an important source pathway?

already_counted.description: Scientific framing, causal synthesis and findings writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain search criteria and source access.

approvals.approved_version: Exact findings checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 40% less retrieval on 15 share gives 6 points less 0.75 upkeep. Low is a new question or native search already configured; synthesis unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the actual environmental work, sample-handling instructions and trainee questions
Supervise or train students, environmental technologists and technicians by demonstrating procedures, observing actual attempts and giving corrective feedback
Write and check actual follow-up feedback on the existing staff work item in {PROJECT}
Post the checked follow-up feedback to the assigned internal work item {PROJECT}

tasks.design: Keep actual staff supervision and training human, with follow-up feedback in the existing {PROJECT} work item. Native identity fields already exist; a new text generator would not remove the need to understand and check the specific technical feedback.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instruction depends on actual attempts and mistakes.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing work item already supports the small written follow-up.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing misunderstood sampling or analysis procedures.

ambition.what: No wider supervisory span is assumed.

evidence.claim: Actual technical coaching requires observation and specific feedback; an existing work item can hold that feedback.

assumptions: Boundary includes procedure review, live supervision and the actual written feedback, explicitly separate before zero. Staff experiment results, performance appraisal and course administration are not duplicated here.
Staff supply actual work and questions. The scientist supplies corrective feedback in s2-s3; no completion or competence is inferred from an invitation or assignment.

Native work-item identity is already the baseline. The remaining feedback is technical meaning, with no established repeated entry to remove. No system change means zero upkeep. Normal author check in s3 binds the exact content and assigned work item.
unknowns: Whether an occurrence needs written follow-up.
research_questions: Is there any repeated administration beyond the existing work-item fields?

already_counted.description: Review, training and actual feedback writing remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact feedback and assigned work item checked in s3; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual review, coaching, writing and posting remain; no new administrative baseline is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual development activity, baseline observations and monitoring requirements
Inspect actual site conditions and capture observations and monitoring readings of environmental effects
Monitor environmental impacts by comparing actual readings with comparable baseline data and interpreting likely development-related changes
Write and check the monitoring update in {DOCS}, including actual observations, limitations and required follow-up
Save the checked monitoring update in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure comparable monitoring views in {BI} and site identity fields in {DOCS}. The scientist captures actual conditions, interprets changes and writes the monitoring update; native views reduce arrangement only and do not infer causation or issue an automatic warning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable readings and monitoring headers may require repeated arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views can preserve site, method and time grouping.
tasks.still_hard: Attributing observed change to development rather than other causes.

ambition.what: No additional monitoring coverage is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less comparable-data arrangement, unchanged field responsibility.

evidence.claim: Native monitoring views can arrange comparable observations, while environmental attribution and fieldwork remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes field monitoring and its update, not statutory submission, control implementation or public warning. Charts already produced under 1523 are reused as inputs where available; their creation receives no second saving here.

The scientist supplies site, time, actual observation, value, unit, method and qualifier in s2, whose full capture time remains. Laboratories supply existing verified result records where used. Missing digital values are entered and checked manually in retained s3-s4 effort.

Native views first. Within s3 only matching and arrangement change; causal interpretation stays full. Within s4 only repeated site headers change. Normal author check binds the completed update; ordinary save stays full.
unknowns: Comparability of baseline methods and actual development records.
research_questions: Can native grouping prevent comparisons across incompatible methods?

already_counted.description: Monitoring-context reading and actual field observation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain monitoring views and site fields.

approvals.approved_version: Exact monitoring update checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Arrangement saves 5 points and headers 1.9, less 1 upkeep. Low is existing views or incompatible baseline data; no fieldwork or interpretation saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use reproducible native data views while retaining environmental interpretation and fieldwork.
reach: Explain monitoring uncertainty to development managers.
role.ambitious_version: A scientist whose conclusions remain traceable to actual environmental observations.

job.title: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
